title: Hide Selected (ArrangeAndOrganize)

scenarios.title: Hide Selected applies its documented behavior
scenarios.expected: Hide Selected (BtnHideSelected) is invoked on the documented fixture deck and produces its documented effect on the selection or presentation, leaves no new entry in %TEMP%\oPenEfficiency\error_YYYYMMDD.log and does not leave PowerPoint or the add-in in an unstable state.

scenarios.title: Hide Selected selection scope matches its metadata contract
scenarios.expected: Hide Selected (BtnHideSelected, MinSelection=1, RequiredType=Shapes) is at 1 selected shape(s) and above and refused below that, refused for an empty selection and for a slide selection. The scenario asserts that the feature's declared [FeatureMetadata] scope drives the production sidebar enablement decision consistently (metadata -> SidebarStateEvaluator, the declared minimum reachable as an enabled button). It does not execute or inspect the command's own selection guard: an enabled command can still refuse a selection, which is why the guard and the PowerPoint effect stay owned by the office-automated leg.

scenarios.title: BtnHideSelected deterministic Office leg

requirements.text: In an isolated real PowerPoint host, the deployed Hide Selected marks every selected shape hidden, reports execution, keeps the shapes recoverable for Show Hidden, writes no new error-log entry, and tears down cleanly.

scenarios.expected: In an isolated real PowerPoint host, the deployed Hide Selected marks every selected shape hidden, reports execution, keeps the shapes recoverable for Show Hidden, writes no new error-log entry, and tears down cleanly.

done.statement: The deterministic Office leg passes against the configured build on an isolated PowerPoint host with zero new error-log entries and full teardown; bind-office-evidence-and-reviews remains until this office scenario has real-host evidence and review.
